2608.07063.title: Soft Redaction of Image Provenance via Zero-Knowledge Proofs
2608.07063.paper_summary: Content provenance standards, such as C2PA, are increasingly used to attach signed records of origin, editing history, and rights to digital images. However, provenance transparency can conflict with privacy -- assertions that strengthen trust in an image may also reveal sensitive information about the creator or capture context. We propose soft redaction for image provenance: a mechanism that replaces sensitive provenance assertions with zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) of selected properties over hidden data. Our work focuses on distance proofs. We first show how location assertions can support proofs of proximity to a public reference point, using Chebyshev polynomial approximations within the ZKP proof circuit. We then extend the approach to L2 distance proofs over biometric embeddings, enabling privacy-preserving claims related to likeness to help enforce personality rights with images. Finally, we apply the same distance-proof construction to perceptual hashes (visual fingerprints), supporting an anti-spoofing use case in watermark-based recovery of stripped provenance metadata. Our results demonstrate that ZKPs over image provenance can provide practical soft-redaction capabilities, compatible with C2PA, that may be constructed in seconds and verified in milliseconds.
2608.07063.paper_summary_zh: 內容來源標準，如 C2PA，越來越多地用於附加簽名的來源記錄、編輯歷史和數位圖像的權利。<lb/>然而，來源透明度可能與隱私相衝突——加強對圖像信任的聲明也可能揭示有關創作者或捕捉上下文的敏感信息。<lb/>我們提出了圖像來源的軟性編輯：一種機制，將敏感的來源聲明替換為隱藏數據的選定屬性的零知識證明（ZKP）。<lb/>我們的工作專注於距離證明。<lb/>我們首先展示了位置聲明如何支持與公共參考點的接近性證明，使用切比雪夫多項式近似值在 ZKP 證明電路中。<lb/>然後，我們將這種方法擴展到生物特徵嵌入的 L2 距離證明，使與相似性相關的隱私保護聲明得以實現，以幫助執行與圖像相關的人格權。<lb/>最後，我們將相同的距離證明構造應用於感知哈希（視覺指紋），支持基於水印的剝離來源元數據的反欺騙用例。<lb/>我們的結果表明，圖像來源上的 ZKP 可以提供實用的軟性編輯能力，與 C2PA 兼容，並且可以在幾秒鐘內構建並在毫秒內驗證。
2608.07063.author: Muhammad Awan et.al.
